title: Teaching a Multilingual Translation Model Regional Varieties: Castilian and Latin American Spanish, Asturian, Aragonese and Aranese with MADLAD-400-3B-MT
abstract: arXiv:2611.33831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Massively multilingual translation models usually have one tag per language and no control over regional varieties, and they cover a region's smaller languages poorly or not at all. We report three fine-tunes of MADLAD-400-3B-MT, each adding target tags with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), back-translation of monolingual text and replay of the base model's own translations: <2es_ES> for Spanish as written in Spain, <2es_419> for Latin American Spanish, and one model for three Romance languages of the Iberian Peninsula, Asturian (<2ast>), Aragonese (<2an>) and Aranese (<2oc_aranes>). For the Spanish varieties we annotate the 250.9M documents of MADLAD-400's Spanish split with a domain-supervised Spain vs. Latin America classifier and select variety text with a rule that admitted no Latin American document in a 340-document reference set. translated_title: 教会多语言翻译模型区分地区语言变体：基于MADLAD-400-3B-MT实现卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语与拉丁美洲西班牙语、阿斯图里亚斯语、阿拉贡语及阿兰语的翻译
translated_abstract: 大规模多语言翻译模型通常每种语言只有一个标签，无法控制地区语言变体，且对某些地区的较小语言覆盖不足或完全没有覆盖。我们报告了对MADLAD-400-3B-MT的三次微调，每次均采用低秩适应（LoRA）添加目标语言标签、对单语文本进行回译，以及重放基础模型自身的翻译：用于西班牙境内西班牙语的<2es_ES>、用于拉丁美洲西班牙语的<2es_419>，以及一个针对伊比利亚半岛三种罗曼语族语言的模型——阿斯图里亚斯语（<2ast>）、阿拉贡语（<2an>）和阿兰语（<2oc_aranes>）。对于西班牙语变体，我们使用一个领域监督的西班牙对拉丁美洲分类器对MADLAD-400西班牙语数据分割中的2.509亿篇文档进行标注，并通过一条规则筛选变体文本，该规则确保在340篇文档的参考集中排除所有拉丁美洲文档。卡斯蒂利亚模型在针对性测试中97%的情况下选择了西班牙的日常词汇（基础模型仅为62%），vos
tldr: 本研究通过LoRA微调、回译和翻译重放技术，成功使MADLAD-400-3B-MT多语言翻译模型能够区分卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语与拉丁美洲西班牙语两种地区变体，并支持阿斯图里亚斯语、阿拉贡语和阿兰语三种伊比利亚半岛小语种的翻译。
en_tdlr: This study teaches the MADLAD-400-3B-MT multilingual translation model to distinguish regional Spanish varieties (Castilian vs. Latin American Spanish) and support three minor Iberian Romance languages (Asturian, Aragonese, and Aranese) through LoRA fine-tuning, back-translation, and replay of the base model's translations.
